title: High-speed performance and scoring remarks
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly mention confident high-speed performance and stability, while many other fragments only reference scores or higher-grade trims without enough context for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong performance, stability, smooth acceleration, fuel economy, and perceived engineering quality at higher speeds.

negative.summary: The negative review complains that noise and vibration become annoying at higher speeds.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention scores, lower ratings, or higher-grade comparisons without enough detail to tell whether they reflect driving performance or another issue.

limitations: Many fragments are too short or incomplete to determine what specifically drove the score or rating comment.
The topic mixes high-speed driving impressions with generic score and higher-grade model references, so not all fragments describe the same aspect.
Examples are limited to the supplied sample and are not representative estimates for all reviews.
